target.label: Future Long COVID diagnosis code
target.definition: First ICD-10-CM U09.9 code 91-455 days after the first documented COVID-19 diagnosis
target.population: Adults with documented COVID-19 and no Long COVID code by day 90

index_event.rule: first U07.1 Condition dated on or after index_event.earliest_date (as in training) and on or before the scoring date; positive tests only if use_positive_tests

features.label: Two or more new symptom types
Emergency visit in the first month
4+ outpatient visits in the baseline year
Visit rate after COVID at least double the baseline rate
Palpitations, tachycardia, POTS, or orthostatic hypotension (coded by day 90)
Muscle or joint pain (coded by day 90)
COVID-19 still coded at a follow-up visit (days 31-90)
New: palpitations, tachycardia, pots, or orthostatic hypotension
New: loss or change of smell or taste
